replay.name: nonce-replay
replay.note: Verify valid[1] twice at its timestamp against one nonce store: first accept, second reject with reason "replay".

conventions.audience: Signatures in valid, invalid and operatorLaunch are for `audience`. A service with another audience re-signs them with the TEST key under its own audience (the conformance runner does this); the unmodified signatures must then fail with `signature`.
conventions.times: `timestamp` and `verifyAt` are Unix seconds; session times are ISO-8601 UTC.
conventions.skew: |verifyAt - timestamp| <= clockSkewSeconds is accepted (inclusive): 60 passes, 61 is stale.
conventions.nonce: A nonce is stored only after every other check passes, and held for nonceTtlSeconds.
conventions.sequences: Each sequence runs its steps in order against one nonce store. `ref` is `<section>/<name>`.
conventions.grants: A grant is prefix + exactly 43 base64url characters; `hash` is lowercase SHA-256 hex of the whole string. Values here are fake.
conventions.returnPath: Must start with basePath + '/', be at most 512 characters, contain no '//', '\\', control/space/DEL/C1 characters or %2e %2f %5c %00, survive WHATWG URL parsing unchanged with the same origin, and not be at or under a forbidden prefix (case-insensitive).
conventions.sessionExpiry: Valid while now < expiresAt (exclusive), where expiresAt = min(expiresAt, createdAt + ttlSeconds).
conventions.revokedAfter: Valid only when createdAt > revokedAfter (strict): a session created at the revocation instant is revoked.
conventions.freshness: Fresh while now - createdAt < maxAgeSeconds (strict): 899s fresh, 900s and 901s not.

valid.name: operator-launch-viewer-skew-plus-60
valid.note: Verified 60s after its timestamp: the skew window is inclusive.

valid.name: operator-launch-owner-skew-minus-60
valid.note: Verified 60s before its timestamp: the skew window is inclusive both ways.

valid.name: operator-launch-utf8-body
valid.note: Non-ASCII body: the hash is over the UTF-8 bytes.

valid.name: operator-launch-query-string
valid.note: The query string is part of the signed path, exactly as sent.

invalid.name: operator-tampered-role
invalid.note: Role raised from admin to owner after signing.

invalid.name: operator-wrong-method
invalid.note: Signed as POST, sent as PUT.

invalid.name: operator-other-endpoint
invalid.note: Operator signature replayed onto the Console launch endpoint.

invalid.name: operator-order-unknown-key-before-stale
invalid.note: Unknown key and stale: unknown_key wins (check 2 before 3).

invalid.name: operator-order-stale-before-signature
invalid.note: Stale and tampered: stale wins (check 3 before 4).

invalid.name: operator-order-malformed-before-unknown-key
invalid.note: Malformed nonce and bad key id: malformed wins (check 1).

invalid.name: operator-malformed-timestamp-fraction
invalid.note: Timestamp must be whole decimal seconds.

invalid.name: operator-malformed-signature-base64
invalid.note: Standard base64 alphabet instead of base64url.

invalid.name: operator-duplicate-nonce-header
invalid.note: The same header twice under different casing counts as malformed.

sequences.name: nonce-replay
sequences.note: Restates the v1.0 `replay` case: valid/console-launch twice against one nonce store.

sequences.name: failure-does-not-store-nonce
sequences.note: A request that fails signature must not consume its nonce.

sequences.name: signature-checked-before-replay
sequences.note: After the nonce is used, a tampered request with that nonce still reports signature, not replay.

sequences.name: replay-within-skew-window
sequences.note: Replayed 60s later, still inside the skew window: replay.

crossAudience.name: realtime-media-signature-at-sodl

crossAudience.name: workforce-signature-at-realtime-media
crossAudience.note: Signed for workforce; Realtime Media must reject it.

crossAudience.name: workforce-signature-at-workforce
crossAudience.note: Positive control for a workforce verifier.
